correction.correct_wording: Within the LNCOR1 source path, SP, SPPI, and SPPSP are assigned at source lines 1262-1264. LNCOR1 initializes the per-line YI/GI accumulators in the preceding loop (lines 1065-1069).

provenance_scope.official_release_compatibility: AER's public LBLRTM repository lists the compatible release combination LBLRTM v12.17 / MT_CKD 4.3 / AER line file v3.8.1.
provenance_scope.locally_pinned_assets: The local line-generation plan identifies and hashes an AER v3.8.1 line-list asset and its generated coupled TAPE3. The separate local build/source and MT_CKD runtime/data pins must be used to establish actual executed asset identity; the public compatibility table by itself does not prove it.
provenance_scope.not_established: This correction does not prove the negative optical-depth samples are physically valid. Signed coupling arithmetic in source and a no-coupling sensitivity response are not physical validation.
